svg.title: Farm-scale P&ID
svg.text: Farm-scale process: air and water P&ID
Per-tunnel aeration with recirculation, shared exhaust to heat recovery and biofilter, heat-metered water loop.
TT temperature · OT oxygen · PT pressure
MT humidity · FT flow · AT ammonia
Indicative. Batches are staggered 5 days apart, so the three tunnels are always in different phases (CE-11). Tags are used by CE-10.
